{"implementation": "def solve(case):
    payload = case["payload"]
    nodes = payload["nodes"]
    required_symbols = set(payload["required_symbols"])
    # Build id-indexed dict and children map
    nodes_by_id = {}
    children = {}
    for node in nodes:
        nid = node["id"]
        nodes_by_id[nid] = {
            "id": nid,
            "parent": node["parent"],
            "symbol": node["symbol"],
            "depth": node["depth"],
            "removable": node["removable"],
            "utility": node["utility"]
        }
        children[nid] = []
    for node in nodes:
        parent = node["parent"]
        if parent is not None:
            children[parent].append(node["id"])
    # Validate: required symbols must be present
    all_symbols = {nd["symbol"] for nd in nodes_by_id.values()}
    if not required_symbols.issubset(all_symbols):
        raise ValueError("Missing required symbols")
    removed = set()
    removal_order = []
    # Sort by depth descending, then id ascending
    sorted_ids = sorted(nodes_by_id.keys(), key=lambda nid: (-nodes_by_id[nid]["depth"], nid))
    for pid in sorted_ids:
        if pid in removed:
            continue
        nd = nodes_by_id[pid]
        if not nd["removable"]:
            continue
        if nd["parent"] is None:  # root
            continue
        if nd["symbol"] in required_symbols:
            continue
        # Check retained children
        child_ids = children.get(pid, [])
        has_retained = any(cid not in removed for cid in child_ids)
        if has_retained:
            continue
        # Compute current symbol set
        current_symbols = set()
        for nid, node in nodes_by_id.items():
            if nid not in removed:
                current_symbols.add(node["symbol"])
        # Remove node's symbol (it is not required, but check anyway)
        current_symbols.discard(nd["symbol"])
        if not required_symbols.issubset(current_symbols):
            continue
        # Perform removal
        removed.add(pid)
        removal_order.append(pid)
        parent_id = nd["parent"]
        # Reattach children to parent
        for cid in child_ids:
            nodes_by_id[cid]["parent"] = parent_id
            children[parent_id].append(cid)
        # Remove node from parent's children
        children[parent_id].remove(pid)
        children.pop(pid, None)
    retained_ids = [nid for nid in nodes_by_id if nid not in removed]
    retained_ids.sort()
    return {
        "retained_ids": retained_ids,
        "removal_order": removal_order
    }
"}

            "id": nid,
            "parent": node["parent"],
            "symbol": node["symbol"],
            "depth": node["depth"],
            "removable": node["removable"],
            "utility": node["utility"]  # not used
        }
        children[nid] = []
    for node in nodes:
        parent = node["parent"]
        if parent is not None:
            children[parent].append(node["id"])
    removed = set()
    removal_order = []
    # Sort node ids by depth descending, then id ascending
    sorted_ids = sorted(nodes_by_id.keys(), key=lambda nid: (-nodes_by_id[nid]["depth"], nid))
    for pid in sorted_ids:
        if pid in removed:
            continue
        nd = nodes_by_id[pid]
        if not nd["removable"]:
            continue
        if nd["parent"] is None:  # root
            continue
        if nd["symbol"] in required_symbols:
            continue
        # Check retained children
        child_ids = children.get(pid, [])
        has_retained = any(cid not in removed for cid in child_ids)
        if has_retained:
            continue
        # Compute current symbol set
        current_symbols = set()
        for nid, node in nodes_by_id.items():
            if nid not in removed:
                current_symbols.add(node["symbol"])
        # Remove node's symbol (it's not required, but check anyway)
        current_symbols.discard(nd["symbol"])
        # Children symbols are already present
        if not required_symbols.issubset(current_symbols):
            continue
        # Remove
        removed.add(pid)
        removal_order.append(pid)
        parent_id = nd["parent"]
        # Reattach children to parent
        for cid in child_ids:
            nodes_by_id[cid]["parent"] = parent_id
            children[parent_id].append(cid)
        # Remove from parent's children
        children[parent_id].remove(pid)
        # Remove child list for pid
        children.pop(pid, None)
    retained_ids = [nid for nid in nodes_by_id if nid not in removed]
    retained_ids.sort()
    return {
        "retained_ids": retained_ids,
        "removal_order": removal_order
    }
